lines: The second grade students were in the middle of their swordsmanship lesson.
Akiyama Rinko, the inheritor of the "Ace Katana Style," got a point against her opponent and was cheered on by her classmates.
Well done, Akiyama. You will be the one representing our school next time.
Rinko took a bow, and her classmates who had been watching came running up to her one by one.
You just transferred schools but you're already first in the grade!
I'm looking forward to seeing the trials! I'll be rooting for you!
Give that delinquent Igawa and that stupidly strong student council president a beatdown too!
Oh, it's lunchtime. Let's wrap up for today!
People were still gathering around Rinko even while she was putting away the equipment.
Hey, Rinko-san, let's go to the cafeteria together!!
Eh? No fair, I'm going with her!
Rinko gave a strained smile as she spotted a frantically running man out of the corner of her eye.
Ah, Rinko-san! Where are you going!?
